$comment: ADR-037 manifest fragment (gateway-federated-api-discovery Task 1, REQ-FEDG-001). The API inventory: every API the discovery synchronizations found on Kong, Azure API Management and Amazon API Gateway, filterable by gateway and vendor through the schema's facetable properties. Read-only: external_api rows are written by the synchronization engine, so the index offers no add, edit or delete. The description says what the Amazon connector waits for (REQ-FEDG-002).

config.description: APIs found on other gateways, next to the API products integriq serves itself. Amazon API Gateway discovery waits on OpenRegister: its credential broker cannot sign AWS Signature Version 4 yet.
